description: Turn your photos into a PDF document — one full-page image per page, sized to each photo. Reorder pages freely, then download a single ready-to-share PDF.

faqs.a: Each page is exactly the size of its image, so nothing is cropped or stretched. Photos keep their original pixels.
faqs.q: Will my photos be cropped or resized?

faqs.a: Up to what your browser can hold in memory. A dozen phone photos works fine; hundreds of very large images may slow things down.
faqs.q: How many images can I add?

faqs.a: No — the PDF is built locally with the pdf-lib library. Your images never leave your device.

howto: Drop your images into the upload zone (JPG, PNG, WebP…).
Use the ↑ ↓ buttons to reorder pages and ✕ to remove any image.
Click “Create PDF” — each image becomes one full-size page.
title: Image to PDF
